method: Manual art-direction review of the final gameplay-scale preview and complete Blob-47 reference sheet, supported by automated texture, geometry, map-composition, build, and package gates.
notes: The prior Epoch 18.1 score is superseded because it did not perceptually verify inner curves or diagonal banks.
Epoch 18.2 is accepted only after the geometry gate verifies all diagonal-bit differences, true 45-degree masks, readable concave-corner radii, and sustained diagonals in the playable opening.
This remains an internal art-direction score, not an independent external review.
